title: Review prime's contract against how beads primes an agent
body: The contract paragraph says how to use each command and nothing about when, or that foam is preferred over a handoff file, a TODO comment or the harness's own memory. Gaps seen in one session: no prompt to foam create when finding work, no trigger or examples for foam remember, no trigger for foam note, stale memories are marked but nothing says to fix or forget them. Compare with what beads injects at session start and decide what the paragraph should say.
